items: lithium battery meter (shunt monitor or BMS-connected SOC display)
why: ChatGPT treated this as a one-product pick: three meter types (BMS-connected SOC display, shunt monitor, voltage LED meter) shown as single items. The shunt and display already ship together as one product, so no second item is needed. The deciding facts are system voltage (36/48/72V; the SmartShunt is not suitable for 72V) and whether the battery's BMS supports its own display, which is a compatibility comparison between single meters, not a set to assemble.
